title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Jurisdiction of Cases by the Shanghai Financial Court

articles.content_en: Article 2 The Shanghai Financial Court shall have jurisdiction over first-instance financial administrative cases within the jurisdiction of the Shanghai Municipality that shall be accepted by an Intermediate People's Court and in which a financial regulatory authority is the defendant.

Article 3 First-instance financial civil and commercial cases and financial administrative cases in which a financial market infrastructure with its domicile within the Shanghai Municipality is the defendant or a third party and that are related to the performance of its duties shall be under the jurisdiction of the Shanghai Financial Court.

Article 4 Where a party appeals against a judgment or ruling made by a Primary People's Court of the Shanghai Municipality in a first-instance financial civil and commercial case or a financial administrative case, such appeal case shall be tried by the Shanghai Financial Court.

Article 5 Where a party appeals against a first-instance judgment or ruling made by the Shanghai Financial Court, such appeal case shall be tried by the Higher People's Court of the Shanghai Municipality.

Article 6 Financial civil and commercial cases and financial administrative cases that have been accepted but not yet concluded by the various Intermediate People's Courts of the Shanghai Municipality prior to the establishment of the Shanghai Financial Court shall continue to be tried by such Intermediate People's Court.
Article 7 These Provisions shall come into force on August 10, 2018.
